sql_schemas: table employee | fields: id, first_name, last_name, email, role, manager_id, department, hire_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employee.id | indexes: email: unique lookup for authentication and identity; role: RBAC enforcement queries filter by role (GP-005); manager_id: direct-report lookups for manager approval workflows; department: departmental leave reports and aggregate queries

table leave_type | fields: id, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: name: unique lookup by leave type name; is_active: filtering active leave types for dropdowns and policy lookups

table leave_policy | fields: id, leave_type_id, role, department, max_days_per_year, max_consecutive_days, requires_approval, allow_carry_over, carry_over_cap, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_type.id | indexes: leave_type_id: policy lookup by leave type; role: role-scoped policy queries; department: department-scoped policy queries

table leave_balance | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, leave_policy_id, year, total_allocated, used_days, carried_over, pending_days, remaining_days, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policy.id | indexes: employee_id: per-employee balance lookups; leave_type_id: balance queries by leave type; year: annual balance scoping; employee_id, leave_type_id, year: unique composite lookup for current balance

table leave_request | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, leave_policy_id, status, start_date, end_date, total_days, reason, manager_comment, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id; leave_policy_id -> leave_policy.id; reviewed_by -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id: employee views own leave history; status: filtering pending requests for manager approval queues; reviewed_by: manager views requests they have reviewed; leave_type_id: filtering by leave type; start_date, end_date: overlap detection when validating new requests; employee_id, status: common composite query for 'my pending requests'; created_at: chronological listing of requests

table audit_log | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, changes, created_at | pk: id | fks: actor_id -> employee.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: lookup audit trail for a specific entity; actor_id: audit trail by user; action: filtering by action type; created_at: chronological audit log queries

methods: findByEmployeeLeaveTypeAndYear(employeeId: string, leaveTypeId: string, year: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>
findApplicablePolicy(leaveTypeId: string, role: string, department: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>
findOverlapping(employeeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
updateStatus(id: string, status: string, reviewedBy: string, managerComment?: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>

data_notes: Six conceptual tables defined: employee, leave_type, leave_policy, leave_balance, leave_request, audit_log. Six repository interfaces with concrete Pg* implementations backed by PostgreSQL via pg Pool. All state-changing operations route through repositories (GP-001). Audit log table and repository satisfy GP-002. Employee role field supports RBAC (GP-005). Leave balance tracks allocated/used/pending/carried-over days with annual scoping. Leave request supports status lifecycle (pending/approved/rejected/cancelled) with manager review tracking. Overlap detection supported via date-range index on leave_request.
